title: Metro Opens
time: A weekday morning, the first sleep after 2.1's scooter decision
player_goal: Ride the Purple Line on opening day.
design_goal: Reveal #13: the metro network (ADR-05 world event). Progress: the map grows from one bus route to a line. Reward: the first ride is free. The Whitefield metro challenges start the station-unlock ladder (game_components §6) that 2.4 IKEA cashes in at Majestic.

cast.role: Gate attendant in a high-vis vest: free today, tokens tomorrow; takes the lost kid if you bring him (+1 rep)
Adi, six, Spider-Man T-shirt, by the garlanded pillar. Challenge #1: follows you (companion) to the guard or to his mother -> lost_kid_returned; gone once returned
In the token queue, hasn't noticed yet; the reunion is the warmer route (+3 rep, -5 stress)
Feeding a torn ₹10 note for the fourth time. Challenge #2: it's free today / press cancel / lend ₹10 -> token_jam_fixed

beats.what: The sleep after the scooter decision: the Purple Line's Whitefield stretch opens (toast), Sameer's chat and a reel land. On the street the blue sheets and the caged pillar are gone - a finished station mouth with stairs, bunting, a flagpole, marigold pots, crowd barriers, a selfie group, a man filming, an aunty with a garland.
Up the stairs into the concourse: ticket counter, two token machines, four gates, the garlanded pillar, the platform and the train beyond. The guard at the gates: free today, tokens from tomorrow.

Challenge #1, the lost kid by the pillar. He takes two fingers of your hand and follows: to the guard (announcement, +1) or to his mother in the token queue (+3, -5 stress). Either way he's gone from the concourse after.
Challenge #2, the token machine jam: it's free today (he won't believe you till the guard waves) / press cancel (it irons the note) / lend ₹10 (he'll GPay you; he won't).
Through a gate lane onto the platform strip: the doors are open. Boarding fades to the coach (2.2b).

assets_needed: metro_props sheet: entrance, bunting, flagpole, barriers, pots, finished pillar (done)
sheets: guard, lost kid, mother, token uncle (done)
street generator: station mouth + flagged spots (done)
acceptance: the first sleep after scooter_decided sets metro_open and metro_free_day; the street draws the station mouth, bunting, flagpole, pots and barriers instead of the barricade and the caged pillar; Sameer's chat and the reel arrive
the station mouth leads to the metro_station pocket (locked with 'Barricades. Not yet.' before the opening); arrival sets metro_station_entered; the guard's line says rides are free today
the lost kid follows once asked; the guard or the mother sets lost_kid_returned (+1 / +3 rep) and the kid leaves the concourse
the token uncle's jam clears by any of three options; lending spends ₹10
the platform strip boards the coach with the Purple Line card
